title: Triggers: an optional name, all or ticked terminals, the new 'send to' wording, edit in the row, and saved across restarts
summary: Injector triggers now take an optional name, watch every terminal (including later ones) or only ticked ones, use the new 'send the message to only that terminal | every terminal it watches' wording, edit in the row, and survive a restart.

deferred.what: Saving an edit of a ticked trigger replaces its watched terminals with whatever is ticked in the Injector at that moment, even for a message-only edit, so a trigger can silently start typing into other terminals; with no ticks, Save is disabled for a message-only edit
deferred.why: Follows the decision 'edit to pick terminals'; changing it is a design decision
